bible_overrides.decision: Conservar crudo/ocre/carbón, Wom y waireñas; sin pala en descanso; rostro casi plano.
Conservar camisa azul humo corta, Wusi, S'ira ocre, Kotin separado arena y paño liso; sin pantalones.

narrative_contract.summary: Motivos paralelos del origen del fuego: descanso de Siki; traslado de dos brasas por Junuunay en otra versión; fuego en la madera. NO son una cronología común. Siki y Junuunay NO se encuentran. Cada escena incluye sólo el personaje asignado.

events.action: Siki, fuego personificado, descansa en chinchorro; primera versión.
Junuunay lleva dos brasas en un morral al salir de la gruta; segunda versión.
El fuego permanece en madera y se obtiene mediante varitas.

influence_by_act.huella: Estratos cálidos condensados en fuego plegado dentro de madera intacta; sin cueva, personajes ni escena.

entrada.beat: La quietud guarda una fuerza todavía contenida.
entrada.escena: 16:9 EXTREME DISTANT ESTABLISHING SHOT. Camera high and FAR AWAY across a vast dry Wayuu courtyard at blue dusk. CRITICAL SPATIAL CONSTRUCTION: this is an inhabited landscape viewed from inside, NEVER a small building model placed on a display floor. The shelter is part of a longer ranchería wall that continues beyond RIGHT image edge. Only the left part of that low shelter is visible at x63–100%, y30–60%; its roof and back wall continue naturally off the right edge. Posts plunge directly into the SAME continuous ground as the foreground. Absolutely NO raised slab, floor plinth, perimeter strip, oval island, concrete block, platform or separate sheet outlining the shelter. Broad terrain sheets flow in ONE uninterrupted color and plane from lower frame edge, BETWEEN the posts, and beneath the hammock; no threshold, rim or seam follows the shelter footprint. ONE adult reclining in one hammock inside that small shelter: body length ONLY 12% frame width. The nearest objects are broad EMPTY ochre CUT-PAPER GROUND SHEETS extending from lower image edge into the distance, with broad irregular overlaps, visible paper fiber and small cast shadows. No granular sand, dirt, soil texture or photoreal ground. Lower 45% is quiet continuous layered paper terrain and left half is free of essential narrative detail, for website title. Several blue paper ridgelines and sparse distant thorn trees occupy narrow far horizon; huge quiet blue paper sky. NOT close up, NO house occupying half image, no foreground framing plants. Inside the shelter ONE small adult SIKI rests calmly, fully clothed with both sandals visible in ONE pale woven suspended chinchorro. Thin yotojoro posts, low straw-paper roof and plain clay-paper wall. Short black hair, plain low wide straw WOM hat, CRUDE CREAM long-sleeve KEMIISA to mid-thigh, ochre WUSI front/back panels held by one CHARCOAL S'IRA sash, brown WAIREÑAS; no pants or shovel. Almost-flat profile face. Impossible detail ONLY inside lower woven belly of hammock: pale outer paper weave remains intact, but through several broad gaps we see a SINGLE long red-and-amber folded PAPER FLAME lying HORIZONTALLY, suspended along curved inner hammock belly BELOW the resting body. Flame tip follows hammock toward tether instead of rising. Intact pale strands pass IN FRONT OF and partially occlude flame; visible air separates weave from warm core. Secret interior of hammock, NOT campfire underneath, orange blanket or burning man. Flame never touches skin or roof. No smoke, damage or suffering. Hammock and man entirely at x68–88%,y44–59%; person remains small. Roof/wall are a continuation of the inhabited world out of the right edge, NOT an isolated complete model. Cold blue sky and distant sparse thorn woodland in physically separated paper planes. No other humans, stars, moon or flames elsewhere. A quiet everyday rest holds impossible contained fire.

acto.beat: Dos brasas pequeñas empiezan a abrir el mundo.
acto.escena: 9:16 WIDE distant view of a narrow path beside a natural gruta in dry Wayuu thorn woodland at cold blue dusk. Cave walls made from large angular gray/sand PAPER sheets at real separated depths. ONE complete young adult JUNUUNAY walks cautiously away from cave at x50%,y42–65%; figure less than quarter image height. Almost-flat brown profile, short black hair under plain sand tied headcloth Ekiialiiijaa; smoke-BLUE long-sleeve KEMIISA just ABOVE knees, opaque charcoal WUSI panels beneath, one plain OCHRE S'IRA sash, separate SAND KOTIN cape over one shoulder, dark WAIREÑAS sandals, bare lower legs, no pants. ONE small plain tan flexible morral supported under forearm at waist, mouth tilted toward viewer. EXACTLY TWO separate charcoal embers with folded RED-AMBER paper interiors visible side by side inside. No bowl, torch or third ember. Other hand hangs, no spell gesture. Magical editorial translation: darkness across path is a broad opaque INDIGO paper plane; at the light of the bag TWO ATTACHED FLAPS of that blue night plane curl outward, one on each side of the morral, opening a seam in the night and exposing a narrow AMBER PAPER path receding behind. Flaps visibly connected to surrounding blue night sheet, air gaps and cast shadows. Night itself opens: not cave doors, wings, extensions of cape, smoke or shooting flames. Bag stays small and intact, embers do not fly out. Main action at y45–60%; lower third empty path for mobile title. Upper two thirds dominated by stone planes and blue depths. Sparse dry thorn silhouettes at different distances. No giant cactus, moon, person in cave, statue, deity, Siki, extra bags or giant flames. Restrained warm light, not inferno. Remote camera, whole body and feet, no portrait.

huella.beat: El fuego duerme donde parece haber sólo madera.
huella.escena: Square 1:1 SYMBOLIC STILL LIFE, no narrative scene. Full-bleed midnight INDIGO matte paper field. TWO plain short dry brown sticks made entirely from layered cut paper lie APART at center, neither touching nor crossed, oblique view from above. One longer irregular stick angles across composition, shorter stick nearby with clear gap. Together occupy about 60% frame width. Bark intact cool brown paper, no char, ash or real timber. In a narrow LENGTHWISE opening in longer stick, the exposed inner wood grain becomes a SINGLE tightly folded RED-and-AMBER PAPER FLAME lying asleep INSIDE wood. Flame silhouette has taper and three simple nested warm folds: unmistakable flame, not red paint or gemstone. Entire tip contained within dry stick outline; no fire rising above. Brown grain layers overlap flame at opening, physically separated with tiny shadows. One impossible fire stored in intact cool wood. Second stick closed plain and unlit, no drill hole. No hands, tools, mechanism, tutorial, people, faces, village, forest, hearth, table, pedestal, sparks, letters, logo or sacred symbol. Large quiet indigo negative space, few confident sculptural paper layers.
